title: Municipal Atlas
scope: This first ledger lists all 351 Massachusetts cities and towns by July 1, 2024 Census population (SUMLEV 061). Tax levy and peer sets are listed as later views. Rankings of change sit on Municipal Rankings.
exclusions: Does not cover Boston-only payroll (that is Boston), statewide multi-metric rankings (Municipal Rankings), or advice about moving. DLS levy files are pending.
heritage: Formerly Choose a City or Town, Economic Snapshot, and Find Peers
vintage_note: Rebuilt Aug 15, 2026 from Census sub-est2024_25.csv, SUMLEV 061 (New England county subdivisions), 351 Massachusetts cities and towns. DLS levy and peer-set files remain pending.
